abstract: Presented are two cases of recurrence of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia more than 1 year after apparently successful therapy. Both patients initially had had nonmetastatic disease, were clinically free of disease, and had had repetitively negative serum radioimmunoassay titers for the beta subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin for 2 to 3 years. The development of these late recurrences re-emphasizes the need for prolonged follow-up monitoring of patients after apparently successful therapy for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
abstract_ja: 治療が見かけ上成功してから1年以上経過した後に妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が再発した2例を報告する。両症例とも初診時は非転移性であり、臨床的には病変がなく、2〜3年間にわたり血清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニットの放射免疫測定値が繰り返し陰性であった。これらの晩期再発は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の治療が見かけ上成功した後も、長期にわたるフォローアップモニタリングの必要性を改めて示すものである。
